summary: USER (2026-06-15): the lossless math still hinges on the 13% drift on the large sample, but that was measured at TEMP 0 (greedy ARGMAX: served argmax != recurrent-decode argmax). Deployment is TEMP 0.6 (sampling), where lossless is DISTRIBUTIONAL not argmax. Design a PROPER temp-0.6 drift gate (the deployment-relevant lossless measure) comparing cat9-spec vs its OWN no-spec recurrent decode, with native-spec-vs-native-no-spec as the FLOOR, THEN decide if the lossless levers (L1 margin-aware commit / L4 boundary fp32) are worth doing. CONFIRM the user: argmax=temp0 is CORRECT; the big-denom 13.55%/13.99% is a temp-0 argmax point-measure that can PASS while temp-0.6 sampling drifts (a sub-argmax distribution shift changes the sampled token even when the top token matches). Design the proper instrument: per-position distributional TV/KL at temp 0.6 between the spec verify-forward dist (q) and the no-spec recurrent-decode dist (p), AND/OR the realized-sample bag-TV with a multi-sample native floor (reuse the banked bag-TV machinery FR13_DRIFT_TRACKER_DESIGN / BAG_TV_FLOOR=0.0593 / fr13_drift_tracker.py, the multi-sample p95-of-C(N,2) native floor) - pick the soundest. Recurrent-oracle frame (NEVER chunked/streamed/serial/backend-name). First-pass estimate on banked data IF the verify dist or multi-seed temp-0.6 streams exist (note: the big-denom oracle recorded the recurrent-decode top-20 log_softmax = p, but the SERVED stream was temp-0 greedy + the spec VERIFY dist q may NOT be banked -> say what is computable now vs needs a fresh temp-0.6 GPU capture). Decision rule: cat9 temp-0.6 drift WITHIN native temp-0.6 floor -> lossless met at deployment temp, NO levers; cat9 ABOVE floor -> levers warranted. CPU read-only (speed campaign holds the GPU - design + banked-data estimate, the fresh temp-0.6 capture queues after). Output FR13_TEMP06_DRIFT_GATE.md.

d.framingConfirmed: CONFIRMED + sharpened (FR13_TEMP06_DRIFT_GATE.md sec 1). argmax=temp-0: at temperature 0.0 the served token is the argmax of the spec verify forward; a "flip" = served_argmax != recurrent_decode_argmax is a POINT measure that fires only when the TOP token changes, blind to sub-argmax reshaping. The big-denom 13% IS exactly this temp-0 point-measure (re-counted from rescore artifacts this task: cat9 1181/8717=13.548% Wilson95[12.846,14.283], native 1224/8752=13.985%[13.275,14.728], CIs overlap, cat9 LOWER, recurrent oracle, serve temperature=0.0, served stream = bare token ids). The four spec-vs-non-spec CODE-READ links (FR13_CONFIRM_SPEC_VS_NONSPEC.md) hold. The distributional gap: temp-0.6 served token is SAMPLED via rejection sampling, so lossless is DISTRIBUTIONAL (q=softmax(verify/0.6) == p=softmax(decode/0.6)); a position can be argmax-identical (temp-0 gate PASSES) yet have a drifted sub-argmax tail that changes the SAMPLED token at 0.6 (temp-0.6 DRIFTS) -- rejection sampling accepts with min(1,p(x)/q(x)) and resamples from norm(max(0,p-q)), so EVERY channel enters the output dist, not just the argmaxes. argmax-flip-rate is a lower-bound proxy, not a measure, of temp-0.6 drift. So the deployment-binding lossless gate is the temp-0.6 distributional one; the 13% pass is necessary not sufficient (bug-class #9: a strictly weaker event measured in place of the deployment event).
d.temp06GateDesign: Two constructions (sec 2). (a) BINDING: per-position distributional TV(softmax(q/0.6), softmax(p/0.6)) + KL(p||q), where q = spec verify forward top-20 log_softmax and p = no-spec RECURRENT decode oracle top-20 (_forward_core_decode_non_spec -> causal_conv1d_update + fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode, gdn_linear_attn.py L806-818/L1045-1097, FR12_NO_SPECULATIVE_CONFIG=1, FLASH_ATTN, single-token roll; NOT chunked-prefill/streamed/serial/backend-name). Temp recovery from banked top-K is valid in principle because the per-position additive constant cancels in softmax over the same support (record truncated tail mass per position for an explicit error bar). (a) is SOUNDEST/most deployment-faithful as the binding instrument: q and p are both conditioned on the same fixed served prefix (forced-decode), so it ISOLATES verify-vs-decode numerical drift from path/RNG non-det and is the continuous quantity that predicts temp>0 acceptance -- and it is ATTRIBUTABLE (per-position over-floor positions localize the carrier for the levers). (b) DEPLOYMENT CROSS-CHECK: realized multi-seed temp-0.6 served streams, bag-TV cat9-vs-native, PASS iff <= p95 of C(N,2) native-vs-native draws -- most deployment-realistic (includes irreducible co-residency reduction-order non-det forced-decode can't remove) but coarser/non-attributable, needs streams not logits. native temp-0.6 bag-TV FLOOR = 0.1133 (139/256 raw mismatch) MEASURED in FR13_NUM_SPLITS_NATIVE_FLOOR_BIND.md (B=4, temp0.6, top_p0.95, seed1313v1313, FLASH_ATTN, CUDA-captured) -- but that is a SINGLE C(2,2) draw = floor center NOT p95; per bug-class #12 it must be upgraded to N=6-8 p95 before hard-thresholding (it already supersedes the stale 0.0593 single-draw at fr13_corruption_gate.py:123). Each arm scored vs its OWN recurrent oracle (apples-to-apples). PAIR the scalar with a per-position view (reference_scalar_metric_per_token_blindspot: bag-TV scalar alone hid a real defect) -- emit the per-position TV(q,p) vector + count of positions over the native-vs-native per-position TV floor, alongside the single drift-tracker scalar D = excess temp-0.6 drift over the native floor.

The peakedness is p-side only, SYMMETRIC between arms, NOT a drift estimate -- it only refutes "argmax-pass => trivially lossless at 0.6" by showing the recurrent target is not a delta at 0.6, so temp-0.6 sampling reaches real sub-argmax mass. d.gpuCapturePlan: Fresh TEMP-0.6 paired capture, recurrent-oracle frame, multi-sample native floor, queued AFTER the speed campaign frees the GPU (sec 4). Stream A (forced-decode q,p per position, for gate (a)): pin the SWE prompt (prompts_swe4.json, capture-once, pin request.json/prompt_token_ids); cat9 served at temp-0.6 capturing the spec verify forward full top-20 log_softmax = q per served position (extend the gold_margin verify-top_logprobs capture to the full stream + record truncated tail mass); feed the IDENTICAL served prefix into the no-spec RECURRENT decode oracle (fr13_recurrent_decode_oracle.py, FR12_NO_SPECULATIVE_CONFIG=1, FLASH_ATTN, single-token roll, NOT chunked) capturing top-20 = p; engagement asserts RECURRENT_PATH_ENGAGED + call-counter>0 (bug-class #9 fail-loud); repeat for native E5 (own verify q + own recurrent p); CPU reduce: per-position TV(softmax(q/0.6),softmax(p/0.6)) + KL, cat9 mean/p95 vs native-arm mean/p95 floor (each vs its OWN oracle) + per-position vector + over-floor count. Stream B (realized multi-seed bag-TV, for gate (b) + the p95 floor): native at N=6-8 seeds (B=4 deployed shape) -> C(N,2) bag-TV draws -> floor=p95 (upgrades the single-draw 0.1133, bug-class #12); cat9 same K seeds -> cat9-vs-native bag-TV PASS iff <= floor_p95; wrap with fr13_drift_tracker.py (K-seed orchestrator over fr13_corruption_gate.run_gate) emitting scalar D + sub-vector, append FR13_LADDER_LOG.md row. Final verdict tier = B=4 + CUDA-captured (co-residency changes at B=4; the floor is a B=4 number); Stream A forced-decode may run B=1/eager for the attributable per-position read but the deployment verdict (b) is B=4. ~2 GPU-days serialized with host-memory recovery between boots.
d.leverDecisionRule: Decided on the temp-0.6 measurement (sec 4), NOT the temp-0 argmax rate (sec 5). WITHIN floor (D<=0: cat9 mean/p95 TV(q,p) <= native-arm TV(q,p) floor AND cat9-vs-native bag-TV <= floor_p95 AND per-position over-floor count <= native-self count) -> lossless met at deployment temp -> do NOT do the levers (they add cost for no measurable deployment gain, feedback_speed_is_the_goal_cost_gate). ABOVE the floor by margin M (=cat9 drift - native floor > 0, CI-separated via paired bootstrap) -> levers warranted; localize M first via the per-position over-floor positions: if excess concentrates at NEAR-TIE positions (small |q_top1-q_top2|) -> L1 margin-aware commit-at-near-tie, predicted to remove the near-tie-attributable share of M by making those positions sample-faithful instead of argmax-committed; if excess is DIFFUSE/boundary-numerical (q-vs-p gap tracks the fp8 verify/lm-head boundary, the diffuse-GDN-accumulation carrier) -> L4 last-stage boundary fp32, predicted to shrink per-position TV(q,p) by the fp32-boundary share. Re-measure D after each lever; a lever ships only if it reduces M toward <=0 at B=4/CUDA-captured WITHOUT regressing the temp-0 argmax rate or accept/event (lossless gate per change). Guard (research-before-deadend): before concluding "lossy at 0.6" confirm the capture isn't confounded (chunked p, unpinned prompt, single-draw floor, BI-flag mismatch = classes #9/#11/#12) + run the adversarial-verify pass. WY parked (not revived); no reward-hack (no rerouting q or p through native machinery to pass the metric).
